The same public frame the hosts resent in journalism reappears in strangers' attempts to reduce David to money.
Repeated amateur intervention and audience spectacle require a standing do-not-replicate medical boundary.
A relationship question becomes a revealing self-portrait of stimulation, wakefulness, and difficulty stopping.
The future interface should let readers move from chapter to raw source, correction decision, and corroborating source without implying that editorial polish is verbatim.
